---
title: Activated on Wrong Domain?
section: License & Domain
---

If you activated your license on the wrong Shopify store, contact support and request a domain transfer.

Include:

- Your order number
- The current activated domain
- The correct target domain




Most transfer requests are processed within 24 hours.
